newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice settles lower on fund, spec selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice settles lower on fund, spec selling.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower again Friday as speculators and commodity funds continued to be heavy sellers, pit traders said.
"We saw fund selling, spec (speculative selling) and long liquidation," said one pit trader.
In anticipation of volatile trade, many traders were exiting positions ahead of first notice day on Monday.
Ongoing favorable weather in the Southeast and Delta continued to generate ideas that the U.S. rice crop is improving despite a cold spring.
"We're seeing really excellent conditions," one floor trader said.
This week's CBOT rice market has fallen to levels that will attract export interest in U.S. paddy rice, a pit trader said.
"The market has moved back to a level where we're going to find some demand," he said.
Volume was estimated at 2,000 contracts, which is slightly above Thursday's actual volume of 1,918 contracts.
Rice closed nine to 13 cents per cwt lower, with July down 12 at $11.18 per cwt.
